Renders from content/pages.json once any page has a menu label;
           until then these hand-written section links stand.
A penn is not bought. It is cut for the hand that will hold it.

We cut reed pens to your nib angle, cook our own soot ink, and burnish paper the slow
            way. Four items open the shop. Put your name down and you will hear first.

The sign-up form is a symbol: drawn once in the builder,
               bound to a backend form in the CMS (Symbols -> Sign-up form),
               placed here and in the closer. Ids are avoided on purpose so
               instances can repeat without duplicating them.
One message when the shop opens. Nothing else, ever.
The four that open the shop
Each lot is cut, cooked, or burnished in one run, then the run closes. Numbers are the order they leave the bench.
Java reed pen, cut to your angle
Seasoned three years, cut at the qatt you name. Ships with a bone qat'ah for the second cut.
Soot, gum arabic, and a long stir. Thirty bottles from a single pot, then the pot is done.
Sized with starch, dried flat, then run under agate until the surface refuses to bleed.
Holds four pens and a bottle upright. Lacquered inside, oiled outside, no hardware.
Three cuts, in this order, no going back
The reed is opened at a long shallow angle so the ink has somewhere to sit. Cut it short and the pen runs dry mid-letter.
One press splits the nib down the centre. It has to stop exactly where the shoulder ends, or the two halves will spread under pressure.
The tip is trimmed against the qat'ah at the angle your script needs — flat for thuluth, oblique for nastaliq. This is the cut you cannot take back.
Can I order before the shop opens?
No. Lot One is cut in a single run and every piece goes to the list in the order names came in. Adding your name is the whole queue.
Do you cut for left hands?
Yes. Say so when you order and the qatt is reversed. There is no extra charge and no extra wait.
How long does a reed pen last?
A season of daily practice, then it wants re-cutting. We send a qat'ah with every pen and instructions for the second cut.
Do you ship outside the country?
Not for Lot One. Ink is a problem at customs and we would rather solve it properly than lose your parcel.
The shop opens once. Be on the list.
